tasks.title: Track A: Multi-view sim2real consistency
tasks.details: 5 training approaches tried (v1–v5), all failed to achieve cross-camera consistency. Root cause: drop_ll makes global color independently random per camera; 12% FOV overlap too small to overcome 88% independent context. Concluded: noise-based training cannot fix LL independence. Next: synchronized denoising (inference-time warp-and-blend) or post-hoc color matching.

tasks.title: FFT/DTCWT as linear operators — paper Method formulation
tasks.details: Unify PPD (FFT) and WPD (DTCWT) as linear subspace selection + in-subband phase preservation. Note: transform T is linear, phase extraction is NOT — phrase as 'linear subspace selection'. Validation experiments: E1-E5 (separate tasks). Write as Method section core formulation.

tasks.title: E1: per-subband domain discriminability (linear classifier AUC)
tasks.details: DTCWT decompose paired vKITTI clone + KITTI real frames (2126 pairs). Per subband (J levels × 6 orientations + LL): coefficient statistics → sklearn LogisticRegression → domain AUC bar chart. Prediction: LL highest AUC, HF phase ≈ 0.5. Justifies drop_ll as 'dropping the linearly domain-separable subspace'. CPU-only, ~1 day.

tasks.title: E2: information budget re-analysis (ρ-axis tradeoff curves)
tasks.details: Convert r/J to preserved-dimension fraction ρ (ρ_FFT ≈ πr²/(HW); ρ_DTCWT = preserved subband dims / total). Re-plot existing vKITTI FID/KID/mIoU curves from logs/vkitti_eval/ on ρ axis. If PPD and ψ-PD curves align in ρ: tradeoff is information-driven; residual gap quantifies locality/orientation benefit. Re-analysis only, ~0.5 day.

tasks.title: E3: structure preservation along denoising trajectory
tasks.details: Instrument inference loop: log per-step DTCWT phase similarity between x̂₀ and sim input, WPD vs SDEdit at matched strength. Prediction: WPD flat retention; SDEdit loses then partially recovers. Mechanistic figure for flow matching connection. Few scenes, ~1 day.

tasks.title: E4: marginal Gaussianity of structured noise
tasks.details: QQ-plots/KS tests on ε_struct per-pixel marginals + covariance spectrum vs N(0,I). Optional: break Gaussianity (leak>0) and show FID degrades monotonically. Explains why pretrained model accepts structured noise. ~1-2 days.

tasks.title: E5: third linear basis (DCT or orthogonal DWT)
tasks.details: Implement structured noise with DCT (or db4 DWT), run vKITTI at 2-3 radii, eval FID/mIoU. Prediction: lands between PPD (global basis) and ψ-PD (local basis). Strongest generality claim but most expensive: ~3-4 days GPU. Optional.
